topic: myth: automated texts sound robotic; written in your own words with the customer's name
hook: POV: you're on a roof at 2 PM and three customers just got a text from you.
caption:
Automated texts that sound like you, for contractors: comment AUTO and I'll reply with how it works.

The worry I hear most about automation? Customers will hate it. It'll sound like a robot.

Only if you write it like one. Dear valued customer gets ignored. Hey Maria, it's Dave, running about 20 minutes out, see you at 2. Nobody in Ohio or Texas reads that and thinks software.

Write it once. It goes out by itself while you're on the roof, for missed calls, on my way texts and Google review requests.

#contractor #smallbusinesstips #automation #n8n #roofing
